essence: Emboss derives directional edge changes from the image and shades them as highlights and shadows, making flat luminance boundaries read like raised or carved relief. Direction chooses the apparent light/shadow orientation; Relief scales the apparent height of those edge transitions, while Contrast hardens or softens their tonal separation. The processed result can then be mixed back with the untouched image.
manifests_as: The image becomes relief-like, with grayscale directional highlights and shadows tracing its edges, often reducing the readability of original color and texture at low original-image mix.

key_levers.name: Direction
key_levers.effect: Rotates the apparent lighting direction, moving which side of each edge receives the bright highlight versus the dark shadow.

key_levers.name: Relief
key_levers.effect: Increases the apparent depth/height of the embossed edge shading; low values are subtle surface relief, while higher values produce stronger raised or carved-looking transitions.

key_levers.name: Contrast
key_levers.effect: Controls separation between emboss highlights and shadows; raise it for crisper, more graphic ridges and lower it for softer, flatter relief.

key_levers.name: Blend With Original
key_levers.effect: Crossfades from the full emboss result at 0% toward the untouched source at 100%, preserving source color and detail as it rises.

key_levers.name: Effect Opacity
key_levers.effect: Scales the visibility of this effect's contribution; lower it to fade the emboss treatment without changing its Direction, Relief, or Contrast relationships.

enums_to_verify.GPU Rendering (ADBE Force CPU GPU, 1-3): Unverified: likely selects an automatic/CPU/GPU rendering preference or capability mode; it should affect processing path/performance rather than the intended emboss appearance.

config_recipes.subtle paper emboss: Direction 135°, Relief 3, Contrast 60, Blend With Original 35%, Effect Opacity 100%.
config_recipes.hard stamped logo: Direction 45°, Relief 18, Contrast 180, Blend With Original 10%, Effect Opacity 100%.
config_recipes.mostly-original textured relief: Direction 120°, Relief 8, Contrast 100, Blend With Original 55%, Effect Opacity 100%.

reasoning_hooks: Relief is the depth lever, but it only reads as three-dimensional when Direction gives the edge shading a believable orientation.
At Blend With Original 0%, the effect can substantially replace the source appearance with emboss shading; raise this blend when original color, texture, or legibility must remain visible.
Direction changes highlight/shadow placement, not the geometric outline of the source; animate it only when moving light or shifting relief orientation is desired.
Contrast can make minor source noise and compression edges emboss visibly, so reduce Contrast or pre-clean the source when unintended texture becomes ridges.
